1. The present petition has been filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. for quashing of FIR No.619/2016 registered at PS Vikaspuri under Section 498A/406/34 IPC.
2.
On perusal of the record indicates that a child namely master Moditya alias Shivu was born out of the said wedlock on 23.03.2016.

3. Let both the parties file an affidavit to the effect that the present settlement shall not affect the rights and interest of the child.
4.

Today, the petitioner has paid a sum of Rs.5,00,000/- by way of Demand Draft bearing No.
060932 dated 27.12.2022 drawn on Axis Bank in terms and conditions of the Settlement dated 20.08.2022.
5.
